modes.definition_zh: 解释事物时不断'向后追问第一因'的做法，主张万物'块然自生'、'独化于玄冥之境'：每一存在皆依其自身之理而然，无所待、无所生，生成链条须在'自生'处截断，转而分析事物各自的内在根据与条件网络。
modes.definition_en: Reject the regress of asking for a first cause: all things are 'self-born' (duhua), each arising of itself in the 'mysteriously dark realm'. Cut off the chain of derivation at 'self-generation' and analyze each thing's own inner basis and its web of conditions instead.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·齐物论》'独化于玄冥之境'
process_zh: 识别问题中隐含的'从某物生出某物'的因果链预设
追问：链条第一环从何而来？揭示无穷倒退或'无不能生有'的困境
在'自生'处截断链条：承认事物依自身之理、在条件网络中'独化'
转向分析该事物的内在之理与其所处条件网络（相因之功）
process_en: Identify the hidden causal-chain assumption ('A is derived from B') in the problem
Ask where the first link comes from, exposing infinite regress or the impossibility of being arising from non-being
Cut the chain at 'self-generation': things arise according to their own principle within a web of conditions
Shift to analyzing the thing's inner principle and its web of mutually conditioning relations
modes.key_quote_zh: 无既无矣，则不能生有；有之未生，又不能为生。然则生生者谁哉？块然而自生耳。
modes.key_quote_en: Non-being, being sheer nothing, cannot produce being; being, before it exists, cannot produce itself. Then who generates the generator? Each thing is simply self-born.
representative_cases_zh: 批评贵无论'有生于无'：无即是无，不能生有，'无'被实体化是一种误置
注'罔两问景'：影非待形而后有，各自独化，'相因'而非'相生'
representative_cases_en: Critique of the theory that being arises from non-being: 'non-being' reified as a substance is a category error
Commentary on 'penumbra asks shadow': shadow does not depend on form to exist; things condition rather than generate one another
modern_applications_zh: 打破'必须找到第一因'的思维定势，转向解释现象的自组织条件
复杂系统分析：解释涌现现象时不强行追溯线性因果链
对'上帝第一因'式论证的哲学检讨
modern_applications_en: Break the habit of demanding a first cause; explain phenomena via conditions of self-organization
Complex systems: account for emergence without forcing linear causal chains
Philosophical critique of first-cause arguments

modes.definition_zh: 每一事物皆有先天'性分'（本性及其界限），价值判断不取外在统一标准，而以'各足其性'为准：判断一个存在是否'得其所哉'，看它是否实现了自身性分之极，而非与他人比较高低。
modes.definition_en: Each being has an innate 'nature-allotment' (xingfen) with its own limits. Value is not measured against a single external standard but by 'fulfilling one's own nature': an entity is well-placed when it actualizes the utmost of its own allotment, not when it outstrips others.
process_zh: 辨识对象自身的'性'——其本性结构与固有界限
拒绝套用外在统一标尺（如大小、贵贱的量化比较）
以'自足其性'为判准：性分之极即是其理想状态
据此安排其在整体中的位置，各司其职、各安其分
process_en: Identify the entity's own nature and its inherent limits
Refuse a single external measuring rod (quantitative comparison of size or rank)
Take 'self-fulfillment of one's nature' as the criterion: the limit of one's allotment is one's ideal state
Arrange each element's position in the whole accordingly, each fulfilling its own function
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫小大虽殊，而放于自得之场，则物任其性，事称其能，各当其分，逍遥一也。
modes.key_quote_en: Small and great differ, yet in the field of self-attainment each lets its nature act, each fits its capacity and its allotment; in free wandering (xiaoyao) they are one.
representative_cases_zh: 重释《逍遥游》鲲鹏与斥鴳之争：大鹏斥鴳各适其性，逍遥无别
论君臣上下：非以能力高下分贵贱，而是性分不同故各居其位
representative_cases_en: Rereading the Peng bird and the quail in 'Free and Easy Wandering': each fulfills its nature, their freedom is equal
On ruler and minister: hierarchy reflects differing allotments, not ranked worth
modern_applications_zh: 个性化教育与人才评价：以'是否充分发挥自身禀赋'替代单一排名
组织设计：岗位匹配以适配性分取代笼统的能力高低论
多元价值观下的成功标准重构
modern_applications_en: Personalized education and talent evaluation: replace single rankings with fulfillment of individual endowment
Organizational design: match roles to natures rather than general ability hierarchies
Reconstructing success criteria under plural values

modes.name_en: Mutual Conditioning, Not Mutual Generation Method
modes.definition_zh: 事物之间'相因'（互为条件、彼此配合）而不'相生'（一物产生另一物）：每个存在独化自生，同时构成他者存在的条件。分析关系时，区分'生成关系'与'条件关系'，避免把依赖误认为派生。
modes.definition_en: Things 'condition' one another (mutual dependence, coordination) but do not 'generate' one another: each is self-born while simultaneously forming the conditions of others. When analyzing relations, distinguish 'generation' from 'conditioning' to avoid mistaking dependence for derivation.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·齐物论》'夫相因之功，莫若独化之至也'
process_zh: 列出对象所处的关系网络
区分：哪些是'相生'式的派生主张（A产生B），哪些是'相因'式的条件关系（A的存在构成B成立的条件）
检验派生主张是否经得起无穷倒退/第一因追问
将可成立的派生主张改写为条件关系，重绘系统图景
process_en: Map the web of relations surrounding the object
Distinguish derivation claims (A produces B) from conditioning relations (A's existence is the condition for B)
Test derivation claims against the regress/first-cause challenge
Rewrite viable derivation claims as conditioning relations and redraw the systemic picture
modes.key_quote_zh: 天下莫不相与为彼我，而彼我均于自得。故独化之足对，非资待之所得。
modes.key_quote_en: All things stand as self and other to one another, yet self and other are equal in self-attainment; the fullness of self-transformation needs no external supply.
representative_cases_zh: 唇亡齿寒之辨：唇齿'相因'（互为条件）而非唇'生出'齿
天地万物'相与于无相与'：万物互不派生却整体协调
representative_cases_en: Lips and teeth: they condition each other, but lips do not generate teeth
All things 'combine without combining': nothing derives from anything, yet the whole coheres
modern_applications_zh: 生态学思维：物种间是共生条件关系而非线性派生链
经济学：市场参与者互为条件，避免'谁创造了谁'的简单归因
组织协作：区分赋能（相因）与制造（相生）两类贡献
modern_applications_en: Ecology: species form symbiotic conditions, not linear derivation chains
Economics: market actors condition one another; avoid simplistic 'who created whom' attribution
Collaboration: distinguish enabling (conditioning) from producing (generating) contributions

modes.definition_zh: '无为'不是不作为，而是'因而不为'——顺物之性、任物之能，不以外在设计强加于系统。治理者/管理者的作用在于创造条件让各要素自为其为，而非事事亲为或以统一模板规训一切。
modes.definition_en: 'Non-action' is not inaction but 'following without forcing': accord with each thing's nature and let capacities act themselves. The governor's role is to create conditions under which elements act for themselves, not to micromanage or impose one template.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·天道》'无为者，非拱默之谓也'
process_zh: 诊断系统各要素自身的'性'与'能'
识别现有干预中哪些是外加的、违背要素本性的
撤除强加性设计，代之以顺应性条件（规则框架而非具体指令）
让各要素'自为其为'，治理者只做协调而不代替
process_en: Diagnose each element's own nature and capacity
Identify interventions that are externally imposed against elements' natures
Remove imposed designs; supply according-with conditions (frameworks, not dictates)
Let elements act for themselves; coordinate without substituting
modes.key_quote_zh: 各安其天性，各用其能，则天机自张，无为而成。
modes.key_quote_en: Each uses its own nature and the innate springs are not obscured; each rests in its allotment and non-action accomplishes itself.
representative_cases_zh: 郭象解'尧治天下'：尧之治在使天下人各得自为，非代天下人为之
论'君无为而臣有为'：上位者任贤使能，不代百官之职
representative_cases_en: On Yao's governance: Yao enabled all under heaven to act for themselves, not act for them
The ruler is non-active, ministers active: superiors entrust the able, never taking over subordinates' duties
modern_applications_zh: 现代管理：授权式领导与赋能平台化组织
公共政策：'放管服'式的规则供给替代微观干预
系统设计：提供约束条件让子系统自组织
modern_applications_en: Modern management: delegative leadership and platform organizations
Public policy: rule-supply over micromanagement
System design: provide constraints that let subsystems self-organize

modes.name_en: Unifying Ritual Order and Spontaneity Method
modes.definition_zh: 反对把'名教'（礼法秩序）与'自然'（本真自发）对立： proper 的名教本身就是自然之性的实现形态。分析与评价社会规范时，检验该规范是否各成员性分的自然展开；是的即'自然'，否则是'矫饰'——用'是否合乎性分'而非'是否取消规范'作为批判尺度。
modes.definition_en: Against opposing ritual order (mingjiao) to spontaneity (ziran): a proper ritual order is itself the realized form of natural natures. Evaluate social norms by testing whether they unfold members' natural allotments; if so they are 'natural', otherwise artificial — the critical yardstick is fit with natures, not abolition of norms.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·逍遥游》'圣人虽在庙堂之上，然其心无异于山林之中'
process_zh: 拆解'自然 vs 规范'的二元对立预设
追问：该规范是否各成员性分的自然展开？
若规范合乎性分——它是自然的社会形态，应当安处其中而非逃离
若规范违背性分——问题在规范错配，而非'规范本身'，修改之而非废除之
process_en: Dissolve the 'nature vs. norms' dichotomy
Ask whether a given norm unfolds members' natural allotments
If yes, the norm is a social form of nature — dwell within it rather than flee it
If no, the fault is misfit of the norm, not norms as such — revise, don't abolish
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫神人即今所谓圣人也。夫圣人虽在庙堂之上，然其心无异于山林之中。
modes.key_quote_en: The spiritual man is precisely the sage: though in the ancestral temple, his mind is no different from being amid mountain forests.
representative_cases_zh: 重解尧让天下于许由：真正的逍遥不必弃天下，'身在庙堂、心在山林'
批评嵇康'越名教而任自然'式的决裂路径：不假外求、不弃人伦
representative_cases_en: Rereading Yao's offer of the throne to Xu You: true freedom need not renounce the world
Against Xi Kang's rupture path of 'transcending norms for nature': no external search, no abandonment of human relations
modern_applications_zh: 职场与生活平衡：不必然以'逃离体制'求自由，可在结构内安顿心性
制度批判方法论：评估制度的'性分适配度'，做改良者而非虚无主义者
儒道互补的现代整合：责任伦理与个体自由并非零和
modern_applications_en: Work-life balance: freedom need not mean escaping the system
Institutional critique: assess 'fit with natures' and reform rather than nihilistically abolish
Modern synthesis of Confucian and Daoist strands: duty and freedom are not zero-sum

modes.domain_zh: 认识论/文本与人格诠释
modes.definition_zh: '迹'是圣贤留下的可见形迹（事迹、制度、文字），'所以迹'是产生这些形迹的内在精神与应变之道。模仿形迹而失其神（'役其迹'）是诠释与实践的典型错误：学习典范须还原其所以迹，再依当下情境重新创迹。
modes.definition_en: 'Traces' are the visible legacy of sages (deeds, institutions, texts); the 'source of traces' is the inner spirit that produced them. Copying traces while losing the spirit is the classic interpretive error: recover the source, then re-create traces fitting the present.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·天运》'夫先王典礼，所以适时用也……岂得以迹为足'之义
process_zh: 识别对象留下的'迹'——其可见产物（制度、文章、做法）
追问'所以迹'：何种精神、何种应变机制产生这些迹？
检验当下'役迹'行为：是否把历史产物当作永恒模板？
依所以迹在当下情境重新'创迹'，弃其过时之迹
process_en: Identify the visible traces (institutions, works, practices)
Ask for the source-of-traces: what spirit and adaptive mechanism produced them?
Test current practice for trace-worship: treating historical products as eternal templates
Re-create traces for the present from the source; discard obsolete ones
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫先王典礼，所以适时用也……时移世异，礼亦宜变。
modes.key_quote_en: The institutions of former kings fit their times... times shift, and ritual must change with them.
representative_cases_zh: 论'复礼'之误：周公之礼是适周时之迹，孔子之圣在所以迹（神），非在迹（礼文）
评'效颦'式模仿：东施效颦，役人之迹，失其所以迹
representative_cases_en: On 'restoring ritual': Zhou's rites were traces fitting Zhou; the sage's essence is the source, not the text
On imitating the frown (the Xi Shi effect): copying another's trace loses its source
modern_applications_zh: 组织学习：反对标杆'照抄'，先还原标杆企业的决策机制再转化
经典的现代诠释：区分文本字面与产生文本的问题意识
个人成长：学榜样之神而非之形
modern_applications_en: Organizational learning: recover the benchmark's decision mechanisms before adapting
Hermeneutics: separate literal text from the problem-consciousness behind it
Personal growth: learn the exemplar's spirit, not their form

modes.name_en: Resting at the Utmost of One's Allotment Method
modes.definition_zh: 面对不可改变的处境（夭寿、穷达、所遇），以'冥然皆与心俱'的方式承认其即吾之分：不在'如果当初'的反事实中消耗自己，而把既成处境转化为自得之场。不是消极认命，而是把认知资源从'改变不可改变者'转移到'展开可展开者'。
modes.definition_en: Facing the unalterable (longevity, fortune, circumstance), accept it as one's own allotment 'in dark accord with the mind': stop consuming oneself in 'what if' counterfactuals and transform the given situation into a field of self-attainment — reallocating cognition from the unchangeable to the expandable.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·养生主》'夫时而适当……冥然皆与心俱'之义
process_zh: 区分处境中'可改变'与'不可改变'的部分
识别自己在反事实思维（'若非…则…'）上的消耗
对不可改变者：以'此即吾分'的方式接纳，终止反事实演算
把全部注意与行动投向性分内可展开的部分
process_en: Sort the situation into changeable and unchangeable parts
Notice consumption in counterfactual thinking ('if only...')
For the unchangeable: accept it as one's allotment and halt counterfactual computation
Direct all attention and action to what one's allotment still allows
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫命行事变，不舍昼夜……推而极之，则今之所谓命者，皆吾之分也。
modes.key_quote_en: Fate and events change without cease... pushed to the utmost, what we call fate is simply our allotment.
representative_cases_zh: 郭象解'安时而处顺'：哀乐不能入，非麻木，而是认知资源的最优配置
论穷达：遇与不遇皆分之内，故'不怨天不尤人'
representative_cases_en: On 'resting in timing and accord': equanimity is optimal cognitive allocation, not numbness
On fortune: meeting and missing are both within one's allotment
modern_applications_zh: 心理韧性训练：斯多噶式可控/不可控二分的中国版本
创伤后适应：从'反事实反刍'转向'分内展开'
不确定性决策：对既成事实止损，保留行动资源
modern_applications_en: Resilience training: a Chinese counterpart to the Stoic control dichotomy
Post-adversity adaptation: from counterfactual rumination to within-allotment expansion
Decision under uncertainty: cut losses on the settled, preserve capacity to act

modes.name_en: Using Words to Catch Meaning Method
modes.definition_zh: 承王弼'得意忘言'而更激进：文本之言是'寄'——作者借语言权且寄放其意，读者须'求言外之意'，甚至承认'寄言'部分本身可以矛盾、可以不真。诠释的目标不是复述文本说了什么，而是抓住文本试图指向什么，随即舍弃语言载体。
modes.definition_en: Radicalizing Wang Bi's 'grasp the meaning, forget the words': a text's words are 'lodged' — the author provisionally deposits meaning in them, and parts of the deposit may even be contradictory or untrue. Interpretation aims not at restating what the text says but at catching what it points to, then dropping the vehicle.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·寓言》'夫庄子之言……寄言出意'之义
process_zh: 读文本时不预设'字字皆真'，标记明显的夸张、寓言、自相矛盾处
问：作者为何'寄'于此言？这段话指向什么问题？
提取言外之意，形成独立于文本措辞的理解
舍弃语言载体（忘言），以自己的语言重述并检验所得之意
process_en: Read without presuming every word is true; mark exaggerations, parables, contradictions
Ask why the author 'lodged' meaning here and what problem the passage targets
Extract the beyond-words meaning, independent of the text's wording
Drop the vehicle: restate and test the extracted meaning in your own words
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫庄子之言，不可以一途诘之……要其会归，遗其所寄。
modes.key_quote_en: Zhuangzi's words cannot be pressed along one track... seek their convergence and leave behind the lodging.
representative_cases_zh: 注《庄子》总纲：庄子之言多为'寄言'，不能按字面坐实（如坐实'尧让天下'史实）
处理《齐物论》内部相互冲突的段落：矛盾正提示读者得意忘言
representative_cases_en: Reading Zhuangzi: most statements are lodged, not literal (e.g., the Yao-Xu You story as history)
Handling contradictory passages in the Qiwulun: contradiction cues the reader to go beyond words
modern_applications_zh: 阅读方法论：对含寓言/反讽/夸张的文本的处理策略
跨文化翻译与诠释：意译优先于字面对应
AI/文档知识抽取：区分文本表述与文本意图
modern_applications_en: Reading strategy for parable, irony, hyperbole
Translation: privilege sense over literal correspondence
Knowledge extraction: separate what a text states from what it intends

modes.definition_zh: 对'大小''高下''贵贱'的比较判断进行釜底抽薪：若各物皆足其性，则大小之别只描述差异、不构成价值等级。遇到任何排位式评价时，先问'标尺从何而来？对谁适用？'，把'优劣判断'还原为'差异描述'。
modes.definition_en: Undermine comparisons of great/small, high/low: if each being fulfills its own nature, differences describe variation without ranking value. Before any ranked judgment, ask where the yardstick comes from and to whom it applies — reduce 'better/worse' to 'different'.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·逍遥游》'夫小大虽殊……逍遥一也'
process_zh: 识别眼前的比较判断及其隐含标尺
追问标尺的来源：谁定的？以谁之性为准？
若标尺非普遍（只是某一性分视角），将'优劣'改写为'差异'
仅在标尺确为相关各方共享且适用的范围内保留等级判断
process_en: Spot the comparative judgment and its hidden yardstick
Ask where the yardstick comes from and whose nature it measures
If the yardstick is not universal, rewrite 'better/worse' as 'different'
Keep ranking only where a genuinely shared yardstick applies to all parties
modes.key_quote_zh: 夫小大虽殊，而放于自得之场，则物任其性，事称其能，各当其分，逍遥一也。
modes.key_quote_en: Compared in form, one thing is smaller; compared in use, another is greater — each fulfilling its allotment, great and small are equal.
representative_cases_zh: 重解'小知不及大知'：郭象反注——小大各适其性，非大贵小贱
论人我比较：以他人之性衡量自己，是'以己养养鸟'式的错置
representative_cases_en: Rereading 'small knowledge falls short of great': each fits its own nature; the great is not nobler
Comparing oneself with others measures one nature by another — a category error
modern_applications_zh: 反'单一成功学'：识别社会比较中的标尺垄断
评价体系设计：多维指标替代单一排行榜
心态调适：把'我不如人'改写为'我所适不同'
modern_applications_en: Against monoculture success metrics: spot yardstick monopolies in social comparison
Evaluation design: multi-dimensional indicators over single leaderboards
Mindset: rewrite 'I am worse' as 'my fitting is different'

modes.domain_zh: 综合方法论/悖论与对立消解
modes.definition_zh: 在概念对立（有无、彼此、是非、内外）无法在任一侧站稳时，不选边也不折中，而是把对立双方追溯到共同的自生根据，使其'玄同'于更高一层的视角：对立是同一根据的两种表现，问题在视角层次而非双方之间。
modes.definition_en: When a conceptual opposition (being/non-being, self/other, right/wrong) cannot stand on either side, neither pick a side nor split the difference: trace both poles to their common self-generated basis and converge them ('dark sameness') at a higher level — the opposition is two expressions of one basis, a matter of perspectival level, not of either pole.
modes.source_chapter: 《庄子注·齐物论》'玄冥之境''与物冥'之义
process_zh: 确认对立双方各自论证的困境（各不能自足）
拒绝在二元内部寻找答案（既不选边，也不机械折中）
上溯双方共同的自生根据（各自皆独化、皆自足）
在更高层次重述问题：对立如何在同一根据上并立
process_en: Confirm that each side of the opposition fails to be self-sufficient
Refuse to answer inside the dichotomy — no side-taking, no mechanical compromise
Trace both poles to their common self-generated basis (each self-born, self-sufficient)
Restate the problem at a higher level: how the opposition coexists on one basis
modes.key_quote_zh: 是以涉有物之域，虽复罔两，未有不独化于玄冥者也。故造物者无主，而物各自造。
modes.key_quote_en: Within the realm of things, even the penumbra is self-transformed in the mysteriously dark; the Creator has no lord, and each thing creates itself.
representative_cases_zh: 有无之辨的终结：'无'不是与'有'对待的另一存在者，有无玄同于'自生'
彼我之辨：彼我皆自得，故'莫若以明'而非彼此相非
representative_cases_en: Ending the being/non-being debate: non-being is not another entity opposed to being; both converge in self-generation
Self and other: both self-attained, so 'illuminate' rather than mutually accuse
modern_applications_zh: 僵持议题的破局：把'二选一'重构为更高层视角下的并立
辩证思维升级：超越'正反合'的机械综合，寻找共同根据
冲突调解：引导双方看见冲突背后的共同条件
modern_applications_en: Breaking stalemates: reframe either/or as coexistence at a higher level
Beyond mechanical thesis-antithesis-synthesis: seek the common basis
Mediation: show parties the shared conditions behind the conflict
